intent: Analyze battery life issue with NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 GPU
detected_fault: Battery life issue lasting only 2 hours even when in sleep mode
suggested_solution: GPU Power Management: Check BIOS settings for power management features.
GPU Driver Updates: Ensure NVIDIA drivers are up-to-date.
Battery Calibration: Calibrate battery by letting it drain to 0% and then charging it to 100%.
Power Management Settings: Adjust power management settings in BIOS or CachyOS.
